description: climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu: natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu. Coverage: climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Urban Heat Island (UHI) intensity (90th percentile), Jan. 2020; Projected number of extreme heatwaves (2068-2100; RCP 8.5; number in 3; Percentage of educational facilities in potential flood-prone areas at; Percentage of healthcare services in potential flood-prone areas at NU. Formats seen: WMS, SHP, TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
